text: invites: colon in client-minted list_id reaches the signed token payload (latent delimiter injection)

Done in fe527d5. Both halves implemented: mint() rejects ':' in list_id (mirroring the existing invited_email check), and redeem() now reads list_id from the invite row. Suggestion 3 (restrict the id charset in _parse_row) was deliberately NOT done: it validates on every push including updates, so it would start rejecting any pre-existing row whose id contains the newly-banned character. mint+redeem close the hole without that risk. Test re-signs a payload naming a different list with the server's own key, so only the DB lookup can catch it.
